heading: Employees
lead: The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall appoint and fix the pay of employees of the Office under regulations prescribed by the President.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised SectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 52131:17(a)(related to employees).June 10, 1921, ch. 18, § 208(a)(related to employees), 42 Stat. 22; Reorg. Plan No. 1 of 1939, eff. July 1, 1939, § 1, 53 Stat. 1423; Reorg. Plan No. 2 of 1970, eff. July 1, 1970, § 102(a), 84 Stat. 2085. The words “attorneys and other” are omitted as being included in “employees”.
